GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (27 May 47) LS-R
(SCAPIN - 1705)
APO 500
27 May 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Suspected War Criminal.
Memorandum to the Imperial Japanese Government dated 10 Jan 47, file AG 000.5 (10 Jan 47) LS_R, (SCAPIN 1455), wherein the Imperial Japanese Government was directed to deliver one KONDO, (FNU), Captain, to the Commanding General, EIGHTH Army at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp), at the earliest possible date, is amended to delete said KONDO's name for the reason that he is now held in Rangoon Gaol, Burma. This name appears as the third name on Page No. 2 of the above mentioned Memorandum.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
